CUEPROMPT CREATOR GUIDE

Keep your sales message focused.

Create product demos, sales videos and client walkthroughs with a browser teleprompter and publishing workflow.

Choose a script template →

Write for the camera, not the page

Start with one audience problem, one useful idea and one clear next step. Keep sentences short enough to say naturally, then use headings and pause markers to make the read easier.

Rehearse in your own rhythm

Keep the reading area close to your lens, adjust text size and speed, and use Smart Follow or steady scrolling. Your draft stays in this browser while you practice.

Record and prepare the release

Record a take, choose a platform export preset, then use the publishing assistant for copy, captions and a local release pack.
